output.summary: Arts' 9-day median is mostly explained by SlotBook tickets (42% of Arts tickets) auto-routed to an unstaffed P4 best-effort queue under RR-17. That queue sits at 0.4 FTE, with a 17-day median wait before first action. Lindqvist's Tuesday/Thursday-only on-site cover explains most of the rest. Arts non-SlotBook tickets match like-for-like tickets elsewhere, so deprioritisation of Arts as such and trivial or duplicate filing are contradicted. The auto-acknowledgement never told requesters about best-effort status. Whether Arts leadership was told of RR-17 is unestablished. Prefer a written support agreement, a corrected acknowledgement and split reporting. Do not pursue all-Arts P4, an Arts desk transfer, or forced CampusBook migration yet.
